LESSON: ULUL-AZM PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Ulul-Azm Prophets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Ulul-Azm Prophets
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What lessons do Muslims learn from the Ulul-Azm Prophets?
